package.description: Connect to your QNAP devices via VPN.

en-US.description: Connect to your QNAP devices via VPN.
en-US.longDescription: The QVPN Device Client is a powerful tool that allows VPN connections directly to your QNAP devices via multiple protocols including QNAP’s proprietary QBelt. With a built-in speed test, you can also easily know the VPN connection speed, and query all the historical connection records at any time.
en-US.name: QNAP QVPN Client

zh-CN.description: 通过 VPN 连接到您的 QNAP 设备
zh-CN.longDescription: QVPN 设备客户端是一项功能强大的工具，可通过多种通讯协议（包括 QNAP 专属的 QBelt），直接连接您的 QNAP 设备。您也可以通过内置的速度测试，轻松掌握 VPN 连接速度，并随时查询所有历史联机记录。
